plain_text_message.value: What kind of crust do you want — thin, regular, or thick?

What size pizza do you want — small, medium, or large?
No worries! Just pick one: small, medium, or large.
Almost there! Is your pizza small, medium, or large?

No problem! Choose your favorite toppings, like cheese or pepperoni.
Last step! What toppings should I put on your pizza?
